morphology.formula: ∅ + took → took（按输入作为完整词形保留）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入中的词根标记予以保留，但不代表马来语词源分析。英语中 took 是 take 的不规则过去式，通过元音变化构成，不含马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词 take 的一般过去式；按搭配可表示拿了、带走了、乘坐了、拍摄了或花费了等。
senses.en_definition: The simple past tense of the English verb take.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kala lampau bagi kata kerja bahasa Inggeris take; padanan bahasa Melayunya bergantung pada konteks, misalnya mengambil, membawa, menaiki atau mengambil masa.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词形，尚无依据将其标为正式马来语词目，因此 status 保留为 unverified。马来语通常依靠时间状语、上下文或 telah 等表达过去，不把 mengambil 变成 took。以下搭配属于英语，ms 字段仅沿用指定结构。释义依据：[Cambridge Dictionary：took](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/took)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场英语培训报告；目标词作为英语词形引用
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam sesi latihan bahasa Inggeris, pengajar menerangkan bahawa took ialah bentuk kala lampau bagi take.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在英语培训课上，讲师说明 took 是 take 的过去式。
dual_scenarios.en: During the English training session, the instructor explained that took is the past tense of take.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论英语作业
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Untuk cerita pasal semalam, guna took, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Untuk menceritakan perkara yang berlaku semalam, kita menggunakan took, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 说昨天的事，要用 took，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: We use took when talking about yesterday, right?
spoken_features: pasal 在口语中表示“关于”，正式表达可用 tentang。
took 是被讨论的英语词形。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tulis took a photo untuk ayat pasal semalam. Betul tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menulis took a photo untuk ayat tentang kejadian semalam. Adakah penggunaan itu betul?
messages.zh: 我在说昨天的那个句子里写了 took a photo，对吗？
messages.en: I wrote took a photo in my sentence about yesterday. Is that right?

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul. Kalau ayat tu ada did, guna take je.
messages.ms_standard: Betul. Jika ayat itu menggunakan did, gunakan bentuk dasar take.
messages.zh: 对。不过句子里如果有 did，就用原形 take。
messages.en: Yes. But if the sentence has did, just use take.

etymology.historical_story: This item belongs to English rather than an established Malay derivational family. English expresses the past of take through the irregular form took, while Malay normally expresses time through context, time expressions or aspect markers. Its appearance in a Malay text may reflect quotation, language teaching or multilingual conversation; it does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 take → took → taken 连成一条记忆链；took 的 /ʊ/ 短促，和 book 的元音相同。这里记的是英语过去式。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友间讨论英语时可以直接引用 took；正式马来语文件应按意思使用 mengambil、menaiki 等准确表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 双语聊天中出现英语很常见，但不要把 took 当作标准马来语动词教授，也不要因对方切换语言而轻率评价其语言能力。
